formRaceEntries.commentStewards: Held up for clear running from the 400m until near the 200m. When questioned regarding his riding from the 600m rider explained that he rode the horse conservatively in an endeavour to make his run to the outside in the straight. He added that from the 600m he was able to find a position behind See That Storm which he felt would provide Cartoon Graveyard a favourable trail into the race and for this reason he did not move wider around Rumbled Again. He added that when See That Storm did not improve, he was then not in a position to move wider, as Jimmy The Bear had improved in advance of him.

formRaceEntries.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward Settled Down 2nd Outside 1 length Beaten 500 ridiculous odds on soft track trial # poor
formRaceEntries.commentStewards: Underwent a vet exam upon arrival having not raced since July 2025 in Europe and was passed suitable to race. Weakened from the 300m. Rider reported that it had been the intention to gain cover however as the gelding overraced it settled further forward than intended and this, coupled with the heavy track conditions, was detrimental to its chances.  A post-race vet exam did not reveal any significant findings. Co-trainer explained they were disappointed that the gelding was unable to settle in a position with cover as they believe it is better suited to settling further back
